title: The Ordinary Postcards
author: Paloma Ravensworth
blurb: August Crane, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
